title: MediahubVideoPublishedPayload
description: mediahub.video.published v1 (OpenVibe.MediaHub server/video/uploads.js): a video a person uploaded or recorded on OpenVibe.Video is public and ready for the first time, so it has a listed watch page. Written to MediaHub's outbox in the transaction that makes it so; making it private and public again does not repeat it. OpenVibe.Quest credits the owner's "Publish a video" quest from it. Envelope: source media-hub (namespace mediahub), subject { type: video, id: <upload id> }, actor the owner, visibility public.

upload.description: The upload id. Also the envelope subject id.
